title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Lead Developer to join our growing engineering team. This role combines hands-on senior development with day-to-day team leadership, working closely with the CTO. You will design and build software while also manage day-to-day engineering operations - including ticket creation and assignment, PR oversight, and team processes.


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is technically strong and has prior experience in a lead role - someone who enjoys writing production code, mentoring a talented senior team, and helping coordinate the day-to-day workflow so the CTO can focus on higher-level direction.


You will work across application code and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with the CTO to deliver scalable, reliable systems and keep a high-performing team running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Engineering Operations

• Work closely with the CTO to manage day-to-day engineering workload and ensure the team stays productive and unblocked

• Own ticket creation, triage, and assignment, keeping the backlog healthy and priorities clear

• Oversee pull request processes, ensuring code quality standards are upheld and reviews are timely

• Maintain and improve engineering processes and standards across a predominantly senior team

• Ensure strong database practices are followed across the team, including schema design, query efficiency, and data integrity

• Serve as a technical point of contact for escalations, cross-team coordination, and architectural decisions


Software Development & Feature Delivery

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET

• Build application features that interact deeply with the database, balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability

• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems

• Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack

• Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers


Azure Cloud & DevOps

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

title: SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients that is a leading healthcare company in the United States, focused on technology, operational resilience, and large-scale enterprise


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate disaster recovery (DR) testing activities across enterprise applications and services
  • Develop and execute structured DR test scenarios aligned with predefined recovery patterns
  • Produce detailed post-test reports, including outcomes, gaps, and recommendations for improvement
  • Track the build-out process of applications and services adhering to established DR strategies
  • Capture and manage corrective action plan (CAP) items in tools such as Fusion or ServiceNow
  • Support the adoption of automated and continuous testing practices for production systems
  • Maintain and manage scheduled (cadenced) DR testing cycles to ensure ongoing readiness
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on testing efficiency and DR process enhancements
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional DR team members and stakeholders
  • Facilitate coordination and execution of DR exercises to reduce risk and improve resilience
  • Support additional DR-related activities and initiatives as assigned by leadership


Required Qualifications

  • Experience in Disaster Recovery, IT resilience, or testing and validation processes
  • Strong understanding of disaster recovery concepts such as RTO, RPO, failover, and service restoration
  • Experience coordinating and executing testing activities in enterprise IT environments
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow for tracking incidents and action items
  • Ability to analyze test results and produce clear, actionable reports
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple testing cycles and priorities
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with effective collaboration skills
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Problem-solving mindset with focus on risk reduction and process improvement


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• International team environment

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Closer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Closer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga


Como Closer na Nutri de Consultório, você será responsável por conduzir as conversas finais com nutricionistas que já demonstraram interesse na Aceleração Nutri de Consultório (ANC), nosso treinamento principal para nutricionistas que querem estruturar e escalar seus consultórios. Sua missão é entender profundamente a realidade de cada candidata, apresentar a ANC como solução real para as dores dela e conduzir uma venda consultiva. Se você gosta de vender, tem habilidades em vendas de ticket alto e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está revolucionando a nutrição no Brasil, este é o seu lugar!


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões de venda consultiva por vídeo/call com leads qualificados pelo time de SDR
  • Realizar diagnósticos aprofundados das dores, objetivos e contexto de cada candidata antes de apresentar a ANC
  • Apresentar a ANC de forma personalizada, conectando os módulos do treinamento às necessidades reais do lead
  • Identificar, antecipar e quebrar objeções com técnica e empatia (preço, tempo, momento profissional, dúvidas familiares)
  • Conduzir follow-ups estruturados e estratégicos até o fechamento da venda
  • Negociar condições de pagamento dentro das condições definidas pela empresa
  • Manter o CRM atualizado com status do lead, próximos passos, gravações e insights de cada conversa
  • Bater meta mensal de receita
  • Reportar os feedbacks e objeções recorrentes dos leads para alimentar marketing e produto
  • Acompanhar as suas métricas de desempenho e buscar evolução contínua


Competências

  • Experiência prévia comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas de ticket alto (a partir de R$ 3.000)
  • Domínio de técnicas de fechamento consultivo (SPIN Selling, quebra de objeções, ancoragem de valor, criação de urgência ética)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal (calls) e escrita (follow-ups por WhatsApp e e-mail)
  • Inteligência emocional e resiliência para lidar com objeções e \"nãos\" sem desgaste
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas claras e ciclo de venda mais longo
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Postura consultiva — você ouve antes de falar, entende antes de oferecer
  • Diferencial: conhecimento ou interesse pelo mercado de nutrição ou educação.


Valores da Empresa

Os valores da empresa regem todos os atos de cada pessoa que faz parte da nossa equipe:

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: AI Motion Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Motion Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Visual Storytelling Designer/AI Creative Producer


About the Role

Our client company (a US-based Creative Agency) is looking for 2–3 highly creative AI-native talents who can combine generative AI, motion design, video editing, and visual storytelling to create modern, high-performing social content for brands and ventures.


This is not a traditional graphic design or video editing role. We are looking for creatives who deeply understand internet aesthetics, AI-powered workflows, cinematic social visuals, and short-form content that captures attention immediately.


You will work across AI-generated imagery, motion graphics, editing, creative direction, and experimental visual concepts to produce premium content similar to the examples below:

  • Fast-paced visual storytelling
  • AI-generated cinematic visuals
  • Social-first brand content
  • Stylized motion design
  • Creative AI advertising assets
  • Premium/High-end startup and venture-style aesthetics


Responsibilities

  • Create visually compelling AI-powered social content for Instagram and paid ads
  • Produce short-form videos using AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, editing, and sound design
  • Develop creative concepts and visual storytelling ideas from briefs or creative direction
  • Use generative AI tools to create unique imagery, animations, environments, and visual sequences
  • Edit high-quality content with strong pacing, transitions, typography, and cinematic composition
  • Stay up to date with AI creative trends, social content trends, and emerging tools
  • Maintain strong brand aesthetics and visual consistency across projects
  • Iterate quickly and efficiently in a fast-paced startup environment


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong portfolio showcasing AI-generated visuals, motion graphics, or cinematic social content
  • Experience creating modern social-first creative content for startups, agencies, brands, or creators
  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, typography, and internet culture
  • Ability to combine creativity with execution speed
  • Self-directed, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Strong aesthetic taste and attention to detail
  • Comfortable experimenting with new creative workflows and AI tools


Preferred Tools & Skills

Experience with several of the following:

  • Runway
  • Midjourney
  • CapCut
  • Kling AI
  • Sora
  • Pika
  • Generative AI workflows
  • Motion graphics and animation
  • Short-form content editing
  • Creative direction
  • Storyboarding and concept development
  • Sound design and pacing
  • Brand storytelling


Nice to Have

  • Experience creating paid social creatives or performance marketing content
  • Understanding of viral short-form content frameworks
  • Experience with 3D or experimental visual workflows
  • Familiarity with creative automation workflows

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.

title: Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

description:

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender uma multinacional líder global no segmento de bens de consumo e transformação digital, com atuação em projetos estratégicos de tecnologia, inovação e expansão internacional.

Estamos buscando profissionais para atuar em iniciativas globais e LATAM relacionadas à transformação digital, omnichannel, AI e implementação de sistemas corporativos , com forte interação entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar na gestão de projetos estratégicos e programas corporativos
  • Garantir acompanhamento de cronograma, escopo, riscos, custos e qualidade
  • Coordenar stakeholders locais e globais

  • Atuar na integração entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital e implementação de sistemas
  • Garantir alinhamento entre times multidisciplinares
  • Atuar de forma hands-on na resolução de temas críticos e acompanhamento das entregas


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como PMO ou em gestão de projetos complexos
  • Vivência com governança, cronogramas multidisciplinares e gestão de stakeholders
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital ou implementação de sistemas
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, PMBOK ou similares )
  • Boa capacidade analítica e organização
  • Inglês avançado e/ou Espanhol fluente dependendo da atuação

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Reasoning/Math) - 75046 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly analytical and computationally proficient individual to join our team with a strong research background. You will be instrumental in contributing to this role by either crafting challenging and insightful problems in your respective research domain, devising elegant computational solutions.


Responsibilities:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks that require multi-step mathematical reasoning, proof construction, or algorithmic problem-solving
  • Design problems that are genuinely hard for a single agent but decomposable — competition math, numerical analysis, combinatorial optimization, statistical inference
  • Create verification scripts that check mathematical correctness — numerical answers with appropriate tolerance, proof step validity, algorithm output correctness
  • Write clear problem statements with precise notation, definitions, and output format
  • Create decomposition guides that split problems into independent sub-computations or parallel solution strategies


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in mathematics, quantitative research, or computational science (e.g., competition math, university-level mathematics, or quantitative research)
  • Strong Python programming skills, including NumPy, SciPy, or symbolic computation (SymPy)
  • Experience writing mathematical proofs or formal derivations
  • Ability to create problems with precise, verifiable answers (not subjective or open-ended)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench and Terminal-bench
  • Comfortable with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)
  • Understanding of numerical methods, including floating-point tolerance, convergence criteria, and error bounds


Nice to have:

  • Experience creating math competition problems (e.g., AMC, AIME, Putnam, IMO, or similar)
  • Research experience in mathematics, theoretical computer science, or quantitative fields
  • Experience with automated theorem proving or formal verification
  • Knowledge of AI reasoning benchmarks (e.g., GSM8K, MATH, AIME, GPQA, ARC-AGI)
  • Experience with large-scale numerical computation or scientific computing


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments required: 40 hours /week with 4 hours of PST Overlap
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 1 month; (expected start date is next week)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Freelance HashiCorp Trainers : Terraform and Vault (Remote)


Company Description

LearnQuest is a trusted global training provider with over 20 years of experience in delivering tailored technology education solutions to leading companies, organizations, and government agencies. Specializing in designing and developing comprehensive training programs, LearnQuest enables clients to access training when, where, and how it is most effective for their needs.

For HashiCorp Terraform:

Send your application to:

title: Portugues and English Bilingual LQA Freelancer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portugues and English Bilingual LQA Freelancer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leader in the online gaming industry, providing Gravity games to gamers across North America and beyond. It is the wholly owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd., a company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Gravity Co., Ltd. is globally renowned for developing the popular MMORPG title, Ragnarok Online, which has captivated players worldwide. With a mission to deliver exceptional gaming experiences, Gravity Interactive continues to serve a diverse and international audience.


Role Description

This is a month-to-month contract role for a Portuguese and English Bilingual LQA Specialist, for the project we estimate to last approximately 6 months. The role involves conducting linguistic quality assurance (LQA) tests for gaming content, identifying and rectifying translation errors, and ensuring linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance in Portuguese and English, ensuring consistency in the use of terminology across game mechanics, in-game items, storyline elements, and related materials. This position will assess text placement within the user interface and make linguistic adjustments where necessary to accommodate language expansion or contraction. The specialist will collaborate with the QA team and other departments when relevant, offering linguistic or localization support to facilitate overall project quality.


Qualifications

  • Be able to translate minimum of 2000 words/day and/or to review/edit 5000 words/day
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong command of written and verbal communication in both languages
  • Experience in Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) testing or localization, with the ability to identify and address linguistic, cultural, and contextual inaccuracies
  • Knowledge of the gaming industry, familiarity with MMORPGs, and a passion for video games
  • Strong detail-oriented mindset, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to meet deadlines in a hybrid work environment
  • Proficiency in translation and localization tools; basic technical aptitude is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, Localization, or a related field preferred
  • Prior experience working in a multicultural environment is advantageous

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Basis Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANA

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Administração e configuração de ambientes SAP (Basis)
  • Suporte e sustentação de sistemas SAP (performance, interfaces e disponibilidade)
  • Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Monitoramento técnico e tuning de performance
  • Execução de rotinas de manutenção (RFCs, profiles, housekeeping, etc.)
  • Planejamento e execução de upgrades e melhorias
  • Gestão de backup & recovery
  • Atuação com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Execução de testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery
  • Participação em modelo Follow The Sun (FTS) para suporte global
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, backlog - ADO)
  • Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis
  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database
  • Experiência com SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Solution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP
  • Conhecimento em backup & recovery
  • Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais e suporte a banco de dados
  • Experiência com scripts (PowerShell ou Shell)
  • Vivência com gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças
  • Inglês avançado (atuação global)


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em HANA Pacemaker
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade
  • Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Freelancing | Video Eval Annotator-PPT | Remote | Immediate Joiner
description:

Video Eval Annotator-PPT

A US based AI company that is at the forefront of AI research is looking for a detail-oriented and analytically consistent Annotator to evaluate visual and creative content using structured rating frameworks and detailed guidelines.

In this role, you will assess AI-generated and real-world media (images and videos) for quality, realism, composition, and adherence to defined evaluation standards. Your work will directly contribute to improving cutting-edge AI systems.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in:

  • Design, Visual Communication, or Fine Arts

  • Architecture or Industrial Design
  • Creative Writing or equivalent professional experience in content creation, media production, or content review.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will complete an assessment.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, candidates can start.

title: Especialista Middleware/SRE Openshift
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Middleware/SRE Openshift em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa dedicada e com vontade de fazer a diferença para atuar na área de Middleware/SRE. Se você ama tecnologia, gosta de desafios e acredita no poder da colaboração para alcançar grandes resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes (OKE) – Instalação, Configuração e Administração de Clusters
  • Participar da instalação, configuração e atualização de ambientes Red Hat OpenShift e Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) em infraestrutura on-premises e cloud, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas, segurança, governança e padrões corporativos. Gestão de Clusters e Recursos Kubernetes
  • Administrar projetos/namespaces, nodes, pods, deployments, replica sets e services, além de configurar recursos como ingress/route, persistent volumes (PV/PVC), config maps e secrets, assegurando alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das aplicações. Implantação e Gerenciamento de Aplicações
  • Realizar deploy de aplicações containerizadas utilizando imagens Docker/OCI, Helm Charts e pipelines CI/CD, garantindo versionamento, estratégias de rollout/rollback e estabilidade dos serviços em produção. Mensageria e Streaming de Dados
  • Administrar, configurar e suportar plataformas de mensageria e streaming como Apache Kafka e RabbitMQ, garantindo alta disponibilidade, performance, retenção de mensagens e integração entre sistemas distribuídos. Cache e Alta Performance de Dados
  • Gerenciar soluções de cache distribuído como Redis, otimizando performance de aplicações, reduzindo latência e suportando cenários de alta concorrência. Monitoramento e Otimização de Desempenho
  • Monitorar consumo de CPU, memória, rede e storage, além de métricas de pods e aplicações utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana e OpenShift Monitoring Stack, identificando gargalos e promovendo melhorias contínuas. Segurança e Controle de Acesso
  • Configurar autenticação (LDAP, OAuth), autorização via RBAC, Network Policies e Security Context Constraints (SCC), além de gerenciar certificados SSL/TLS e políticas de segurança para workloads críticos. Automação e Integrações
  • Automatizar provisionamento e operações utilizando Ansible, Operators e APIs Kubernetes, além de integrar plataformas com ferramentas de CI/CD, observabilidade e sistemas corporativos. Troubleshooting e Análise de Logs
  • Diagnosticar falhas por meio de análise de logs de pods e nodes (oc logs, oc describe), eventos do cluster e métricas, utilizando debug containers e ferramentas especializadas para resolução de incidentes complexos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em Red Hat Openshift, OKE, Apache Kafka e RabittMQ.
  • Configuração de Alta Disponibilidade
  • Experiência em orquestração de aplicações em containers, garantindo alta isponibilidade e escalabilidade por meio de réplicas, HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) e balanceamento de carga nativo do OpenShift.
  • Otimização de Desempenho (Tuning);
  • Ajustes de recursos (requests/limits de CPU e memória), otimização de JVMs em aplicações containerizadas, configuração de probes (liveness/readiness) e afinamento de conexões para melhorar resiliência e performance.
  • Scripting e Automação (CLI e GitOps)
  • Habilidade em automação de tarefas usando oc CLI, YAML/Helm Charts e integração com GitOps (ArgoCD/Tekton) para pipelines de CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo.
  • Integração com Banco de Dados
  • Configuração de secrets e configMaps para conexão segura com bancos de dados (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.), além de otimização de conexões e uso de serviços externos com Service Binding.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas Operacionais e Containers
  • Proficiência em Linux, containers Docker/CRI-O, namespaces, segurança com SELinux e controle de recursos no ambiente de execução.
  • Noções de Redes e Segurança
  • Entendimento de service mesh (como Istio/OpenShift Service Mesh), TLS/SSL, Network Policies e autenticação/autorização com OpenShift OAuth e RBAC para garantir segurança de aplicações e comunicação entre serviços.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas
  • Análise rápida de falhas em containers, pods e pipelines, com uso de ferramentas como oc logs, oc describe e observabilidade integrada (Prometheus, Grafana, EFK/ELK).
  • Gestão do Tempo e Priorização
  • Organização para lidar com múltiplos projetos e demandas simultâneas em ambientes críticos, priorizando de acordo com impacto ao negócio.
  • Colaboração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Interação com desenvolvedores, SREs, arquitetos de soluções e equipes de segurança para garantir entrega contínua e integração fluida no cluster.
  • Comunicação Eficaz
  • Clareza ao transmitir informações técnicas para equipes técnicas e de negócio, além de documentação estruturada de pipelines, deployments e práticas recomendadas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Certified Professional
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure DevOps Professional
  • Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
  • Red Hat Certified OpenShift Administrator


Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;

100% remoto;

Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Senior QA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior QA em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Analys t is a key contributor to the delivery of high-quality solutions within Agile Squads operating in Core Banking environments. This role is accountable for defining, implementing, and continuously improving quality practices across the full delivery

lifecycle, ensuring compliance with banking regulations, internal controls, and enterprise architecture standards.


The Senior QA acts as a quality leader within the Squad, proactively identifying risks, preventing defects, and supporting informed release decisions — particularly in mission-critical and highly regulated financial systems.


Key Responsibilities

Quality Leadership & Governance

•Act as the quality authority within the Squad, ensuring adherence to enterprise quality standards, testing strategies, and compliance requirements.

•Promote a quality-by-design approach across discovery, development, and delivery phases.

•Ensure alignment with banking governance, audit, risk, and compliance controls.

Core Banking Domain Expertise

•Validate complex Core Banking workflows, including:

Account lifecycle (opening, maintenance, closure)

Transactions, fees, interest, and balances

Integration with payment rails, channels, and middleware layers

Regulatory and disclosure requirements

Data consistency across core systems

Requirements, Discovery & Refinement

•Engage early in discovery and technical refinements, challenging assumptions and ensuring clarity and testability of requirements.

•Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, and Developers to define robust acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, regulatory impacts, and operational risks.

•Ensure stories meet Definition of Ready (DoR) and are suitable for implementation and testing.

Test Strategy & Execution

•Define and execute comprehensive test strategies covering functional, integration, system, end-to-end, and regression testing across Core.

•Validate business rules, exception scenarios, and cross-system dependencies.

•Ensure test coverage supports production-grade readiness.

Test Automation & Continuous Testing

•Lead or contribute to test automation initiatives (API, integration, regression, and UI where applicable).


Required Qualifications

•Extensive experience as a QA Analyst in Agile/Scrum environments.

•Proven hands-on experience with Core Banking systems.

•Strong understanding of banking processes, transaction flows, and regulatory constraints.

•Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies and quality governance.

•Experience with JIRA and test management tools.

•Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

•Experience with test automation frameworks (API and/or UI).

•Background in highly regulated financial environments.

•Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

•Familiarity with BDD practices (Given / When / Then).

•Experience supporting audits and compliance reviews.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP).   • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Planning/Operations) - 75063 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for AI Benchmark Engineers specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:

  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables

Develop verification scripts to evaluate:

  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)

Build decomposition strategies:

  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Basis Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANA

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Administração e configuração de ambientes SAP (Basis)
  • Suporte e sustentação de sistemas SAP (performance, interfaces e disponibilidade)
  • Troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes críticos
  • Monitoramento técnico e tuning de performance
  • Execução de rotinas de manutenção (RFCs, profiles, housekeeping, etc.)
  • Planejamento e execução de upgrades e melhorias
  • Gestão de backup & recovery
  • Atuação com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Execução de testes de Disaster Recovery e Cyber Recovery
  • Participação em modelo Follow The Sun (FTS) para suporte global
  • Atuação em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, backlog - ADO)
  • Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis
  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database
  • Experiência com SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Solution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP
  • Conhecimento em backup & recovery
  • Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais e suporte a banco de dados
  • Experiência com scripts (PowerShell ou Shell)
  • Vivência com gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças
  • Inglês avançado (atuação global)


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimento em HANA Pacemaker
  • Experiência com ambientes de alta disponibilidade
  • Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Regional Study Director, LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional Study Director, LATAM em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.


Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.


Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

  • Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM.
  • Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM.
  • May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM.
  • Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc.
  • Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs.
  • Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation.
  • Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives.
  • Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities.
  • Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors.
  • Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms.
  • Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate.
  • Outline regional activation hurdles for team.
  • Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities.
  • Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed.
  • Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed.
  • Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations.
  • Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed.
  • Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results.
  • Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals.
  • Make timely, data-driven decisions.
  • Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered.
  • 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role.
  • Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements.
  • Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems.
  • Excellent understanding of drug development process.
  • Experience in clinical trial supply management.
  • Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution.
  • Analysis and report generation.
  • Knowledge of local regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential.
  • Study initiation procedures.
  • Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action


Travel:

You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Senior GCP QA Auditor – Full Time – Permanent – Remote – South America

At Zigzag, you will become a pivotal member of our team, working alongside industry leading experts and delivering our client’s quality assurance aspirations and outcomes.


What we are looking for

  • Extensive auditing experience in GCP. Thorough knowledge of GCP.
  • Additional knowledge of another GxP areas (GLP, GCLP, GMP, CSV, PV) would be advantageous.

What You’ll Do With Us

Auditors target will be to work to 70% utilisation, which could require up to 50% travel to client sites, that doesn’t mean you’ll be away from home for months at a time, as we ensure we schedule assignments for a fair work/life balance.


Our auditors are deployed to audit Investigator Sites and Vendors, as well as eTMF audits which are done remotely.


You’ll support our clients with Inspection Readiness and Inspection Management related activities across a diverse range of roles and regulatory bodies.


Who We Are

ZigZagQA is a trusted global leader in QA management, offering true global reach and unrivalled expertise to reduce risk and efforts. Working as an extension of our clients team, our experts increase capability and efficiency with collaborative, comprehensive and customized QA programs.


We partners with a wide range of clients across the entire drug discovery and development process to improve GxP Quality against global regulatory standards. We work with top 20 Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology companies, all the way to startups.


We strive for excellence, aiming to be the number one choice for our clients and our employees. We are passionate about Continuous Improvement and are always looking for a ‘better way’.

We are a global, quality leader who put people first and forge lasting relationships to bring deep impact in the industry.

Não é vaga de SDR.

Não é atendimento ou suporte.

Conduzir uma campanha de migração de clientes da base antiga da XpertiON para os planos atuais da empresa.

O profissional será responsável por conversar com clientes ativos, explicar o reenquadramento de planos, conduzir a negociação e registrar os resultados.

  • Contatar clientes da base atual;
  • Conduzir conversas por WhatsApp e telefone;
  • Apresentar a migração para os planos atuais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de upsell;
  • Negociar com firmeza e profissionalismo;
  • Registrar contatos, retornos, recusas e migrações em planilha ou CRM;
  • Reportar diariamente os indicadores da sprint;
  • Passar clientes migrados para o time interno da XpertiON.
Perfil desejado

Buscamos alguém com:

  • Experiência em venda consultiva B2B;
  • Experiência com carteira de clientes, pós-venda comercial, upsell ou account management;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Energia comercial alta;
  • Organização e disciplina de execução;
  • Capacidade de falar sobre preço sem insegurança;
  • Foco em meta, performance e resultado;
  • Disponibilidade para começar rápido.
Formato do projeto
  • Modalidade: PJ;
  • Duração inicial: 15 dias;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Atuação em base ativa de clientes;
  • Início imediato.
Remuneração
  • R$1.000 de entrada no início do projeto;
  • R$1.000 na segunda semana, mediante avaliação de execução;
  • R$100 por migração concluída;
  • Bônus de R$1.000 ao atingir 30 migrações concluídas.

Potencial de ganho: até R$6.000 em 15 dias , conforme performance.

Avaliação de continuidade

Após a primeira semana, será feita uma avaliação de desempenho considerando:

  • volume de clientes abordados;
  • conversas realizadas;
  • propostas apresentadas;
  • migrações aceitas;
  • organização dos registros;
  • qualidade da execução.

Caso a performance esteja alinhada, o projeto segue até o fim da sprint. Caso contrário, a XpertiON poderá encerrar a contratação ao final da primeira etapa.

Importante

Essa vaga é para quem gosta de meta, velocidade e conversa comercial direta.

Se você tem perfil passivo, depende de lead quente ou evita negociação de preço, essa vaga não é para você.

  • Se você sabe trabalhar carteira, gerar expansão e conduzir cliente com segurança, queremos conversar.
